- Around line 32-39: The current testContextTimeout constant (and other related
timeouts defined nearby such as restoreContextTimeout and any per-test timeouts
around the same block) is too short for the serial test flow and causes flaky
context deadline errors; increase testContextTimeout to a safer value (e.g.,
10m) and proportionally raise restoreContextTimeout and any short poll/update
timeouts used by the serial flow (look for symbols testContextTimeout,
restoreContextTimeout, clusterCSIDriverUpdateTimeout, operatorHealthTimeout) so
chained operations have adequate headroom—update all other occurrences flagged
(the other constants referenced in the comment) to match the new expected
durations.
- Around line 103-105: The hybrid detection logic is too permissive: replace the
current predicate that sets isHybridEnvironment using only
len(nodesWithoutLabel) > 0 with the stricter check used elsewhere (require both
vSphere-labeled nodes and unlabeled nodes), i.e., compute isHybridEnvironment =
len(nodesWithVSphereLabel) > 0 && len(nodesWithoutLabel) > 0 (use the same
condition as the other test), and add an explicit branch to handle the "neither"
case when neither labeled nor unlabeled nodes are present so the test does not
take the hybrid path incorrectly; update all occurrences (the variable
assignments and any conditional branching that relies on isHybridEnvironment,
including the block that currently uses allNodesAreVSphere and
isHybridEnvironment) to use the new predicate consistently.
- Around line 271-276: The current loop only logs configv1.OperatorUpgradeable
when condition.Status == configv1.ConditionTrue, but the failing-path of
interest is when the OperatorUpgradeable condition is False; update the check in
the conditions loop (the block that inspects condition.Status, condition.Type
and calls GinkgoWriter.Printf) so that it also logs when condition.Type ==
configv1.OperatorUpgradeable and condition.Status == configv1.ConditionFalse (in
addition to the existing OperatorDegraded True case), ensuring the diagnostic
message (condition.Reason and condition.Message) is emitted for the
false-upgradeable case.
